canonical_claim: Given an infinite structure M for a first-order language L and every sufficiently large infinite cardinal kappa, there is an L-structure N of cardinality kappa that is elementarily equivalent to M. The statement phase must decide whether the checked presentation uses the direct equivalence theorem or the stronger upward elementary-extension form.
source_phrase: 无穷模型有任意大的初等等价模型

canonical_formal_target.environment_fingerprint: toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.29.0; mathlib 8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95; exact minimal imports and options open

domain_and_universes: A first-order language L, an L-structure M, a target cardinal kappa, and an output L-structure N; precise universe lifts remain for the statement phase.
quantifiers: Intended order: L, M with an L-structure, infinitude of M, kappa, cardinal lower bounds, then existential N and an elementary embedding M to N.
hypotheses: M is infinite; kappa is at least the relevant language and source-model cardinalities. Exact lift equations and whether aleph_0 is explicit remain open.
conclusion: An L-structure N of cardinality kappa elementarily equivalent to M; a stronger elementary-extension witness may be used only with a checked implication bridge.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Finite source structures; target cardinals below the required bounds; a merely equicardinal type without an L-structure; or a model with no checked elementary relationship to M.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical/cardinal-choice dependencies not yet frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib; exact import closure remains open
computation_profile: noncomputable model-existence theorem expected; no oracle or experimental evidence credited
owners_and_reviewers: Stage1 execution owner and independent model-theory/source reviewers remain to be assigned by integration
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on statement, source, toolchain, mathlib, profile, or validator change; review due at statement activation.
status_boundary: A planned intake only: no exact Lean expression, H0, M0, R0, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
